ablation.notes: Phase-616 first controlled training-side experiment. Keep tokenizer, solver_i2sb, sigma0p02, endpoint orthogonal lowanchor050, TopoGate, terminal SWD, eval contract, batch, and parent fixed. Change only the training target from raw matched endpoint to source_low + target_high with kernel=5 and low_anchor=1.0, so low-frequency structure is hard-anchored in the objective instead of being recovered only by inference geometry.
